name: moru-benchmark-dimensions
description: A benchmark that evaluates models across multiple 'dimensions' of performance (e.g., capabilities, reliability, and safety-related attributes), providing structured multi-faceted scores rather than a single metric. It is designed to profile models on various evaluation axes to support comparative analysis and risk assessment.
reputation: An emerging safety- and evaluation-focused benchmark from a niche community (sentientfutures); referenced within safety research circles but not yet a widespread standard.
